house_personality_setup.title: Set up House Personality
house_personality_setup.description: Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider and the assistant personality.

data_description.context_entity: Optional entity that provides home or household context.
data_description.identity_entity: Optional entity that identifies the current speaker.
data_description.location_entity: Optional entity that provides person, home, room, or area location context.
data_description.memory_entity: Optional entity that provides read-only memory context.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum provider response tokens. Use 0 for the provider default.
data_description.tools_enabled: Pass Home Assistant Assist tools to compatible providers for exposed-entity state and control.
data_description.tool_choice: OpenAI-compatible tool choice sent when tools are enabled.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: Allow compatible providers to request multiple tool calls in parallel.
data_description.response_format: Optional OpenAI-compatible response_format value. Use default for broad provider compatibility.
data_description.recall_enabled: Enable optional read-only conversation recall from a configured service.
data_description.recall_service_domain: Service domain for the recall adapter.
data_description.recall_service_name: Service name for the recall adapter.
data_description.recall_limit: Maximum number of recall items to request.
data_description.recall_include_turns: Allow the recall service to include supporting conversation turns.
data_description.vision_enabled: Enable optional read-only event or vision summary context.
data_description.vision_entity: Optional entity that provides recent event or vision summary text.
